project_title: FA CHE 花車: The Flower Float
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a persistent single-canvas React Three Fiber scene for West Kowloon harbourfront at dusk using purely Three.js primitives (Box, Cylinder, Sphere, Plane, Cone, Tube/Torus, Points) with no external GLTF/OBJ/texture downloads.
HUD overlays are layered on top of the R3F Canvas using absolute/fixed positioning with pointer-events-none on containers and pointer-events-auto on interactive cards/buttons.
Ensure CJK Traditional Chinese characters render crisply by importing Noto Sans HK and Noto Serif HK via Google Fonts in index.html or index.css.
All panels must respect the viewport layout rules so the dressed food truck in the center-right is NEVER fully obscured on 1366x768 and 1920x1080 screens.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, HUD chips, dialog buttons, meters, and menu items.
Use @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei (or pure Three.js Canvas bridge) compatible with React 19 / CRA; install via yarn: 'yarn add three @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei canvas-confetti'.

hud_layout_matrix.viewport_visibility_guarantee: The central dressed cart (Fa Che Florist) sits at 3D world center (x: 0, y: -0.2, z: 0) facing camera slightly angled. Left HUD panels (Conversation, Notebook, Market Intel) occupy left 38% width max (w-[360px] to w-[420px]). Right HUD panels (Flower shelf, Inventory, Live meters) occupy right 35% width max (w-[340px] to w-[400px]). The center viewport (min 450px) remains completely transparent so the 3D decorated truck is always visible.

top_bar.position: fixed top-3 left-4 right-4 z-40 flex items-center justify-between pointer-events-none
elements: Title badge ('FA CHE 花車' with live Typhoon status T1/T3/T8)
Top-right Action cluster: In-game Menu button, 'Start a new run', 'Skip Cinematic' button

left_dock.position: fixed left-4 top-16 bottom-4 w-[380px] z-30 pointer-events-none flex flex-col gap-3
elements: Kit delivery rider speech bubbles (docked top-left or speech bubble anchored over cart)
Uncle Wing conversation panel (scrollable dialogue history, 3 quick reply chips, text input + Send, 'Ask the market' button)
Needs Notebook accordion (Budget, Desired Colours, Festival Goal, Cultural Taboos)

right_dock.position: fixed right-4 top-16 bottom-4 w-[380px] z-30 pointer-events-none flex flex-col gap-3
elements: Live 4-Meter HUD: Budget (HK$ spent / max, turns crimson when exceeded), Luck (%), Crowd Appeal (%), Storm Proof (T1-T8 rating)
Flower Shelf (12 HK traditional flowers grid, price HK$, cultural meaning, hardiness stat, active badges, '+' to dress cart)
Market Intel panel toggle ('Market notes (offline)', storm trajectory, rival food truck hints)

bottom_dock.position: fixed bottom-4 left-[400px] right-[400px] z-30 pointer-events-none flex justify-center items-center gap-4
elements: 'Brace for the Storm' major CTA button (neon-amber glow, triggered when truck is prepped)
Cart Rotation slider / Orbit hint to inspect 3D flower arrangements
